Open Start and type your company name and your own numbers in the yellow cells: labour rate, target margin, deposit rule, sales tax, energy price and the ingredient for the price rise test.
Keep Ingredients current: type the price per kilogram or piece. Recipe lines, Products and every margin update at once.
Check Recipe lines for each product in grams or pieces, then read Products: ingredient, packaging, labour and energy cost, margin, cost per serving and the price for your target margin.
Set the wanted margin for each category on Margin targets. Products and orders below it are marked.
Use Cake sizes and Decoration levels with the Custom cake quote and the Tiered cake planner to price a celebration cake in minutes.
Record every quote on Quotes: the estimated cost, margin, deposit and follow-up check fill in, and quotes without a reply are flagged.
Log every price change on Price changes and every supplier change on Ingredient price changes. The last change dates feed Products and Ingredients.
Check Wholesale price list, Competitor price checks and Seasonal price rules before each quarter.
Read Orders profit sample and Cost by month to see which orders and which months lost margin, and Labour time log for jobs that ran over their planned minutes.
Test recipe changes on Recipe tests: cost change, taste score and the decision.
Use the 14 calculators before you quote: recipe cost, cake quote, tiers, scaler, target price, ingredient rise, labour, energy, boxes, wholesale, deposit, discount, break-even and a what-if grid.

Read the Costing and Pricing Dashboard and Charts every week: margin by category, quote acceptance, ingredient price changes, order profit and labour time gaps.

Orders, quotes, deposits and daily limits for home bakeries and cake businesses
every order shows its lead time, total, deposit asked and balance, with the rush and deposit flags filled in by themselves
each quote shows its deposit, the days left, an expiry flag and the follow-up outcome, so no quote dies without a reply
the due date, the paid date, the days late and a status for every deposit, with an overdue amount on the dashboard
Allergy note check on every order
each allergy note is matched with the allergens of the cake and marked as checked or not checked before the bake
busy dates with the expected orders, the last day to order and the days left, so a cut-off is never missed
a limit for cakes and tiered cakes for each day with the slots left and a full flag before a day is overbooked
theme, colours, the message on the cake and the day the client approved the design, with every unapproved brief flagged
the deposit kept or refunded by the days before the due date, the refund amount and a note for the client
enquiries, orders and conversion by month and channel show which source turns messages into paid orders
repeat clients with an upcoming birthday or anniversary, the last day to order and a ready message to bake again
clients waiting for a full day with the state of that day, so you offer the spot the moment one opens
the days before the due date decide the rush surcharge, the new price, the tax and the total before you say yes

The order book with deposit and balance
One row for each order from the first enquiry to the due date; the lead time, the total, the balance after the deposit, the deposit flag and the rush flag fill in by themselves.
Quotes with days left and an expiry flag
One row for each quote sent with the quoted price and its status; the deposit, the days left, the expiry flag and the days without a reply fill in by themselves.
Enquiries with days waiting for a reply
One row for each enquiry with the channel, the occasion, the wanted date and the budget; the days waiting and the reply flag fill in, so a message left unanswered stands out.
Deposits with the due date and days late
One row for each deposit with the date it is due, the amount and the date it was paid; the client, the days late and the status fill in, so a deposit not yet paid stands out.
One row for each payment: deposit, balance, full payment or refund; the order total and the share of it that this payment covers fill in.
Clients with orders, spend and days since the last order
One row for each client with the first and last order, the number of orders and the spend; the days since the last order and an active or lapsed flag fill in.
Products with price, servings and shelf days
The 24 products with servings, price, labour minutes, shelf days and allergens; the price for one serving fills in.
The price factor and the labour factor for each decoration level; the order total and the quote tools use them.
Order changes with the effect on the price
One row for each change to a confirmed order with the old and the new total and the reason; the price effect, the effect flag and the client phone fill in.
Cancellations with deposit kept and refund
One row for each cancelled order with the deposit, the part kept and the reason; the refund, the days before the due date and the deposit result fill in.
Allergy notes with the check on the recipe
One row for each order with an allergy note and who checked it; the client, the product, its allergens and a recipe check fill in, so an unchecked note stands out.
Occasion calendar with order cut-off dates
The busy dates of the year with the expected orders and the last day to order; the days to the cut-off and the status fill in, so a holiday cut-off is never missed.
The six ways clients reach you with the orders of the whole history and the share of enquiries that became orders.
Daily cake limits with slots left
The most celebration cakes and tiered cakes the team can bake for each day; the slots left and the full flag fill in, so you stop taking orders for a day before it is overbooked.
Clients who want a day that is full with their phone and cake; the days to the date and the state of that day fill in, so you can offer the spot the moment one opens.
Design briefs with the approval date
One row for each decorated cake with the theme, colours, message and the date the client approved the design; the client, the days to the due date and the approval status fill in.
One row for each follow-up of a quote with the date, the outcome and who handled it; the client, the quote date and the days since the quote fill in.
Birthday and occasion reminders for repeat clients
Repeat clients with an upcoming birthday or anniversary, their last category and spend; the days to the date, the last day to order and the order flag fill in.
Enquiries and orders by channel and month
One row for each month and channel with the enquiries, the orders, the delivery orders and the order value; the conversion fills in, so you see which channel turns enquiries into orders.
